notes: 27 synthetic symptoms across five IT support domains specific to FIT HANU campus environment (Nhà C, HANU_Student WiFi, portal.hanu.edu.vn, lms.hanu.edu.vn, Lab C1/C2/C3, fit@hanu.edu.vn). Not real incident reports.

symptoms.description: Device connects to HANU_Student but the captive portal login page does not appear
Laptop cannot see HANU_Student or HANU_Staff network in the available Wi-Fi list
Wi-Fi connects to HANU_Student, then drops every few minutes inside Nhà C
HANU_Student connects in the corridor but drops signal immediately inside Lab C1 or Lab C2
Wi-Fi works on a phone but not on a laptop on the same HANU_Student network
Captive portal accepts username/password but immediately redirects back to the login page
AIN301 course does not appear in the FIT LMS (lms.hanu.edu.vn) course list after registration
Assignment submission on FIT LMS fails with a file-size-exceeded error
FIT LMS session expires immediately after login, forcing re-login every few minutes
Attendance record on FIT LMS shows absent despite the student being present in class
FIT LMS submission page shows a deadline that has already passed, but the announced deadline is still open
Lab workstation in Lab C1/C2/C3 shows a GRUB boot error and will not load Ubuntu
Lab workstation keyboard or mouse is unresponsive at the login screen
Lab workstation cannot connect to the LAN switch (no network icon, no IP assigned)
Projector in room C202 or C301 does not display the laptop screen when HDMI cable is connected
Lab workstation screen shows colour lines or flickering after boot
HANU student email (@hanu.edu.vn) password has expired and the self-service reset link does not arrive
Microsoft 365 (Office 365) HANU licence shows as 'unlicensed' after a recent password change
Cannot log into portal.hanu.edu.vn — account locked after multiple failed password attempts
Student account is suspended on the training portal, preventing grade viewing
Two-factor authentication (2FA) code for the HANU portal is not received on the registered phone
Shared printer in FIT Office (P.210 Nhà C) shows 'Offline' in the operating system
Print job stays in queue and never prints on the P.210 shared printer
Printer in P.210 prints blank pages
Print output is faded or streaky on the P.210 shared printer
Print job succeeds from the instructor's computer but not from a student laptop on the same network
Printer shows a paper-jam error in P.210 even after the jammed sheet has been removed
